search.label: Paste an ID or link, or scan a QR code
search.hint: Passport IDs (ODP-…) and profile IDs (C-123-456-789-012, or B-, P-, M-) can be pasted from a label, a site link, or the square QR button.
search.existsYes: This Passport ID is registered on the primary contract.
search.existsNo: This Passport ID is not registered on the primary contract (full verify may still try older deployments).

result.badToken: That doesn’t look like a Passport ID, profile ID, or a link from this site. Passport IDs start with ODP-. Profile IDs look like C-123-456-789-012 (also B-, P-, M-).
result.loadFail: Can’t load registration data right now. Check your internet connection and try again.
result.notRegisteredBody: This ID does not exist in the registry. The object may not be registered, or the ID may be incorrect.
result.creatorNotFoundBody: This profile ID does not exist in the registry, or the ID may be incorrect.
result.noPublicUrlDesc: No hosted file URL on record — only someone with the canonical .odpass bundle (or the passport data inside it) can verify details and authenticity

proof.lead: Separate tool from registry verify above: prove control of the issuer wallet for a passport — no gas. The recovered signer must match passport.creator on-chain. This is key control, not legal authorship.
proof.panelSignHint: Use the issuer wallet, enter Passport ID, pick a file, and sign canonical proof of file possession.
proof.panelVerifyHint: Upload the same file and paste the JSON bundle. The page rebuilds canonical message and verifies EIP-191 signer against on-chain passport.creator.
proof.optionalPassportIdSuffix: (optional if Passport ID is inside JSON bundle)
proof.fileDropLine2: Only this file can be proven
proof.fileDropLine3: Upload the same file as in proof bundle

instProof.trustBody: Anyone can register as a P-type institution — names are self-declared and unverified. Only the profile ID (P-NNN-NNN-NNN-NNN) is on-chain. Find this exact ID published on the institution's official website to confirm identity.
instProof.noNoteHash: No noteHash was stored for this proof — you cannot compare a file hash on-chain for this entry.
instProof.checkLead: Drop or choose the same file the institution attested. The page hashes it locally and compares to noteHash above.
instProof.checkTitle: Choose file to compare with on-chain noteHash
instProof.dropLine1: Drop file here or click to select
instProof.dropLine2: SHA-256 computed in your browser — not uploaded
instProof.mismatchDetail: The file you chose produces a different SHA-256 than the on-chain noteHash for this proof.
instProof.findProverTail: on the institution's official website to verify identity. No human-readable name is shown here — names are self-declared.

tools.lead: Choose a tool to open it in this Verify workspace.

dataUrl.odpassHostedBanner: Hosted dataUrl returned a §15 .odpass ZIP — passport.json was read from the bundle (normative; raw JSON at dataUrl is not allowed).
dataUrl.noPassportInZip: Hosted URL looks like a ZIP/.odpass, but passport.json is missing inside.
dataUrl.rawJsonUrlNotAllowed: This dataUrl points at a .json file — SPEC §9 requires a .odpass bundle at the public URL. Upload the ZIP and update dataUrl.
dataUrl.requireOdpassZip: dataUrl must return a §15 .odpass ZIP (application/zip or ZIP local header). Raw JSON body is not allowed at the public URL.

bundle.dataMismatch: The passport JSON inside this .odpass does not match on-chain dataHash for {id}.
bundle.sidecarOriginalMissing: Digital original missing in bundle (expected path in manifest.originals.fileHash or legacy original/)
bundle.sidecarImageMissing: {label} missing in bundle (manifest.originals or legacy image folder)
bundle.verifiedImagePreviewAlt: Bundle image whose SHA-256 matched the chain

odpQuick.label: Or drop a .odpass file
odpQuick.dropLine1: Drop .odpass here or click to select
odpQuick.banner: Source: {name} — data from this .odpass was hashed here and compared to the chain. The hosted dataUrl was not used.
odpQuick.unregisteredHint: Contents below come from your file ({name}). This registry has no matching passport — the bundle is not confirmed on-chain.
odpQuick.noPassportJson: passport.json not found inside the bundle.
odpQuick.badPassportId: passport.json must contain a valid Passport ID (ODP-…).
odpQuick.jszipMissing: JSZip failed to load. Check your network and reload the page.
odpQuick.rejectNonOdpassFilename: The reference verifier only accepts bundles whose filename ends with “.odpass”. Export again from the Passport page if needed.

paffAudit.title: P affiliation — on-chain audit
paffAudit.lead: Enter a child institution Profile ID (P-…). Read-only: active parent and join/detach timestamps from the registry.
paffAudit.badChild: Enter a Profile ID that starts with P-.
paffAudit.needNet: Wait until the network status connects (or check your RPC).
paffAudit.noSupport: No deployment returned affiliation audit (try a v0.3 registry).

creatorResult.registeredDesc: This wallet is linked to a profile on-chain.
creatorResult.institutionalTrustNote: This profile ID is registered in the registry. The label (Institution / Museum) is not verified on-chain — confirm this exact ID on the organization’s official website before trusting proofs or institutional claims.

passportJson.passportIdRow: Passport ID (passportId in JSON; legacy humanId accepted)

localPreview.sectionMoreTitle: More details from the passport file

detail.odpassSidecarPaths: New-style packages keep extra files in a folder called originals. Older packages may use different folder names — checking still works the same way.
detail.localOdpLead: Drop the .odpass file you saved when you created the passport. This page reads the passport from inside it and compares it to what the public registry stored — on your device, without uploading the file.
detail.localOdpDrop1: Drop .odpass here or click to select
detail.localOdpDrop2: Compared in your browser — file is not uploaded
detail.c2paManualLead: The passport lists this fingerprint: {hash}. If you used a content-credentials tool for the same file, paste what it shows and tap the button below.
detail.c2paInvalidHash: Paste a fingerprint in the form your tool gives (often a long hex code, sometimes starting with sha256: or 0x).
detail.numberedSealBody: This object uses a numbered sticker without a chip your phone can challenge. You cannot fully check the number online — inspect the physical seal. A skilled faker could copy the number onto a fake object.
detail.nfcChipBody: Cryptographic seal: the chip can show if it was removed. Use the maker’s compatible app to run verification on the object.
detail.auxExplain: This fingerprint is separate from the main passport file. If you use this extra file (for example a certificate), check it on its own.
detail.noUrlBody: The registry has a fingerprint for the picture but no web address. Drop the image file below to compare manually.
detail.dropOriginalL1: Drop the original file here or click to choose
detail.dropOriginalL2: Fingerprint computed on your device — file is not uploaded
detail.dropImageL1: Drop the image here or click to choose
detail.dropImageL2: Computed on your device — not uploaded
detail.dropImage2L1: Drop the second image or choose a file
detail.dropImage3L1: Drop the third image or choose a file
detail.fileMismatchNote: This file is not the same as the one on record. Expected fingerprint: {expected}

docAttest.lead: Connect your wallet, choose a file, and submit attestExternalDocument. This proves your wallet anchored this hash.
docAttest.noInjected: No browser extension wallet. Use “Mobile (WalletConnect)” or install MetaMask.
docAttest.fileDropLine2: Hash is computed locally before submit
docAttest.previewWhat: You will record on-chain that you have this file
docAttest.previewHow: Another person with the same file can compute the same hash and verify that you confirmed this file
docAttest.uriLabel: Optional public URL for the same file (HTTPS)
docAttest.uriNotHttp: Use an http:// or https:// URL.
docAttest.uriInvalid: That URL could not be parsed.
docAttest.genUnsupported: This registry generation does not support document attestation.
docAttest.successDesc: Hash {hash} is now anchored by your wallet.
docAttest.successDescWithUri: Hash {hash} is anchored; documentUri {uri} was stored on-chain.
docAttest.docAnchorMissing: This deployment is not set up for “anchor my document” yet. Whoever runs the site needs to add the document-anchor address to the network settings (see project README).

doc.lead: Upload a file to compute SHA-256 locally and immediately check on-chain who already anchored this hash.
doc.fileDropLine2: On-chain search starts automatically after hashing

qr.title: Scan QR
qr.hint: Point the camera at the QR code on the label or screen.

time.onChainUtcHint: The chain stores a Unix timestamp in seconds; the registry treats it as a UTC instant.
time.localFromJsonHint: Wall-clock time and IANA zone as recorded when the passport file was built — the same instant as above.
